beats.say: This tortoise can go a whole year without food or water.
The giant tortoise. Some weigh over five hundred pounds.
It stores water in its bladder, like a living canteen.
And it can live for more than a hundred years.
That's exactly why sailors loved it.
They stacked them alive in the ship, as fresh meat for the trip.
Pirates, whalers, and seal hunters all did it.
As many as two hundred thousand tortoises were lost.
Their oil was even burned to light lamps in the city of Quito.
Today, only about twenty thousand roam the Galapagos.
The islands are named after them. Galapago meant saddle, like their shell.
Charles Darwin climbed onto their backs, and rode them.
He said keeping his balance was very hard.
It sleeps about eighteen hours a day.
Little birds dance in front of it, and it stretches out its neck so they can eat its ticks.
And it's not a picky eater. It will eat dead tortoises. And poop.
Five hundred pounds, a hundred years old, and it snacks on poop.
Follow me. Next, a worm that doctors still put on people.
